features.feature: Default fixed recovery-runner protocol remains null ablation plus B1-B15 when no exploratory profile is supplied; B1-B15 constants and existing counts are preserved.
Explicit exploratory scenario profile support accepts weighted and list/subset profiles behind an explicit mode without changing canonical defaults.
Invalid exploratory profiles fail closed for unknown scenario ids, malformed or duplicate weights, and zero or negative weights before records or sidecar logs can mislead.
Docs state the safe offline exploratory boundary and non-goals, including no fountain/erasure recovery, no lifecycle gate shortcut, and no unattended production readiness claim.

Lifecycle DONE/review/evidence hash semantics and gate implementation files remain excluded/protected; this story must not modify lifecycle gate consumers, process-fact registries, DONE-required validation, review-run signing, or evidence freshness semantics.
features.excluded_by: CHK-002 context limits implementation to exploratory recovery-runner parsing and says to avoid lifecycle gate semantics; CHK-004 documents not lifecycle gate evidence.
